title: Details Matter
problem: Halves every hit, even weak ones, and blocks the attacker's Capitalize / Judgment Day. Community: "just 50% DR".
notes: In-game test:  Fix: H | 2026-10-26 realign (text is the contract): text claims "always take damage as if they are strong against their enemy's class". H: Details Matter (bc_EventDamage L4005-L4008): set the class result to 'defender strong' (x0.5 of the neutral hit) instead of halving every hit and zeroing strength (which also blocks Capitalize / Judgment Day). vs bugged: mixed. | In-game test: Details Matter team takes a hit the attacker is weak on: damage is not quartered (ends at half of a neutral hit, same as strong-on-them hits).

release_notes.intended: Your creatures always take damage as if they were strong against the attacker's class.
release_notes.actual: The game halved whatever the class matchup gave: hits from attackers strong against your creature ended at normal damage, hits it already resisted ended at a quarter, and it blocked effects such as Capitalize.
release_notes.fix: Now every hit on your creatures is treated as a 'strong against' hit: half of a neutral hit.
